info.name: Resolves and redirects a provided Audius app URL to the API resource URL it represents

params.name: url
params.description: URL to resolve. Either fully formed URL (https://audius.co) or just the absolute path

items.docs:
This endpoint allows you to lookup and access API resources when you only know the
audius.co URL.
Tracks, Playlists, and Users are supported.
